verdict.label: Full review
verdict.summary: X (Twitter) is not in Composio's toolkit catalog, requiring a custom OAuth app configuration.
verdict.cost: Free/Tiered depending on X API plan

composioFit.summary: Since X (Twitter) is not managed by Composio, you must configure a custom auth config with your own OAuth credentials.
whyOwnApp: X (Twitter) is not in Composio's toolkit catalog.
You need your own OAuth app client ID and client secret.

phases.name: Create Composio Auth Config
steps: Go to the Composio dashboard auth configs page.
Click Create Auth Config and choose OAuth2.
phases.handoff: Copy the redirect URI for your X developer portal app.

phases.name: Register App in X Developer Portal
steps: Register an application in the X developer portal.
Add the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
Retrieve the Client ID and Client Secret.
phases.handoff: Paste Client ID and Client Secret back into Composio.

blockers.symptom: X (Twitter) toolkit not found in managed catalog
blockers.cause: X (Twitter) is NOT in Composio's toolkit catalog.
blockers.fix: Use a custom auth config with your own X developer credentials.

checklist.text: Navigate to the Composio dashboard and create an auth config
Register an application in the X developer portal
Add the Composio redirect URI to the X developer app
Copy Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio dashboard
